records.title: Joint corporate accounting standard
records.summary: GHG Protocol and ISO announced a consolidated corporate standard. Their revised plan places consultation in Q2 2027 and publication in Q4 2028.
records.change_note: The announced work combines corporate inventory standards into a joint development programme; publication remains a future milestone.
records.action: Keep an inventory of accounting policies that may need reassessment when the consultation text is available.
records.applicability: A development plan is not a new reporting obligation. Assess future requirements once final text and adoption arrangements are available.
records.check_note: Announcement and quarter-level milestones checked against the official FAQ. No review of the full development plan or entity applicability was performed.

developments.label: Joint programme and revised timetable announced

records.title: Scope 2 accounting revision
records.summary: GHG Protocol published consultation feedback on electricity accounting. Further proposals remain subject to its standard-development process.
records.change_note: Consultation feedback is available; it is not a final replacement accounting standard.
records.action: Record assumptions behind electricity procurement claims so they can be tested against future proposals.
records.applicability: Do not treat consultation preferences as adopted accounting rules.
records.check_note: Feedback publication checked against the official FAQ. No separate finalisation date is asserted here.

records.title: Land Sector and Removals Standard
records.summary: The Land Sector and Removals Standard addresses land emissions and carbon removals. The official resource page gives an effective date of 1 January 2027.
records.change_note: The standard was initially published on 30 January 2026; the resource page also lists subsequent non-substantive edits and supporting guidance.
records.action: Identify relevant land and removal activities, then review the latest standard and guidance before changing inventory methods.
records.applicability: An accounting standard’s effective date is distinct from a statutory filing deadline. Coverage and any reporting-programme adoption need separate assessment.
records.check_note: Publication and effective date checked on the official resource page. This record does not reproduce the standard or claim a technical conformity review.

sources.title: Land Sector and Removals Standard resources

developments.label: Initial Land Sector and Removals Standard publication

records.title: Corporate Net-Zero Standard V2.0
records.summary: SBTi released Version 2.0 in June 2026. Its implementation notice sets 1 February 2027 as the opening date for target validation under the new version.
records.change_note: Publication and availability for validation are separate events. Existing target cycles require their own transition assessment.
records.action: Check your target renewal date and the programme’s transition guidance before choosing a submission version.
records.applicability: This is a target-setting programme, not a jurisdiction-wide statutory disclosure mandate.
records.check_note: Release and validation-opening dates checked against SBTi’s implementation notice. Sector-specific and company-specific transition requirements are not evaluated.

records.title: IFRS S2 greenhouse gas disclosure amendments
records.summary: The ISSB issued targeted greenhouse gas disclosure amendments to IFRS S2. They apply to annual periods beginning on or after 1 January 2027, with early application permitted.
records.change_note: The amendments provide reliefs and clarifications rather than replacing the full climate disclosure standard.
records.action: Compare the amended provisions with your reporting policies and confirm the version recognised by the relevant jurisdiction.
records.applicability: ISSB publication alone does not impose a universal legal obligation. Local adoption and the reporting entity’s circumstances determine applicability.
records.check_note: Issue month and effective-period wording checked against the IFRS announcement and completed-project page. No jurisdiction adoption review was performed.

sources.title: ISSB issues targeted amendments to IFRS S2
Completed project: greenhouse gas emissions disclosures

milestones.label: Effective for annual periods beginning on or after this date

records.title: CBAM definitive regime
records.summary: The European Commission states that the definitive Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism regime applies from 1 January 2026 to covered imports.
records.change_note: The regime has moved beyond its transitional phase. Import-specific obligations must be assessed under the applicable legislation and guidance.
records.action: Map relevant goods, customs roles and supplier emissions data before determining your organisation’s obligations.
records.applicability: Product codes, exclusions, thresholds and the importer’s circumstances require assessment. This record makes no in-scope determination.
records.check_note: Regime commencement checked on the Commission’s definitive-regime page. Filing and certificate deadlines are intentionally not inferred.

developments.label: Definitive regime begins (effective event, not article publication)

records.title: SEC climate-rule rescission proposal
records.summary: The SEC’s rulemaking page lists a proposal to rescind its climate disclosure rules. The page gives a public-comment deadline of 3 August 2026.
records.change_note: The listed action is a proposed rescission, not evidence that a final rescission has taken effect.
records.action: Monitor the rulemaking docket for a final action and assess other applicable disclosure obligations separately.
records.applicability: This record concerns one federal proposal. It does not establish the status of state rules, litigation or general securities disclosure duties.
records.check_note: Proposal classification, issue date and comment deadline checked against docket S7-2026-19. This is not a comprehensive court-docket search.

sources.title: S7-2026-19: Rescission of Climate-Related Disclosure Rules

comparisons.distinction: Keep the method used to calculate an inventory separate from the requirements governing its disclosure. A change to one does not by itself establish a change to the other.
comparisons.question: Which accounting method and which disclosure rule does your reporting basis reference?

comparisons.distinction: An emissions inventory and a validated target answer different questions. This tracker does not assume that a proposed accounting treatment is accepted by a target programme.
comparisons.question: Has the target programme explicitly recognised the accounting treatment you intend to use?

comparisons.distinction: Avoid treating a corporate inventory total as a substitute for the information required for a particular imported good. Map data needs and boundaries independently.
comparisons.question: Can you trace the data for the relevant goods, processes and reporting boundaries?

comparisons.distinction: Do not infer domestic legal applicability from a global standard, or infer changes in other jurisdictions from one national proposal.
comparisons.question: Which jurisdiction, entity and reporting period have you actually assessed?
